source: 733 Praise You
target: 733, Te laudamus

source: Finishing the last stroke, Anthony sighed in relief, confirming he still lived.
target: Ultimum ictum perficiens, Antonius ex solacio suspiravit, confirmans se adhuc in vita esse.

source: Though unsure if Amon’s incarnation–Monette’s drawn form–could help turn the tables and find a way out of the mirror world, he had obeyed his partner’s orders and done his part.
target: Quamquam incertus an incarnatio Amonis — forma delineata Monette — casus convertere et viam e mundo speculi invenire posset, iussa socio obtemperaverat et suum munus egit.

source: Almost at once, Anthony saw the corners of Monette’s sketched mouth turn up, eyes appearing to come to life.
target: Paene statim, Antonius vidit angulos ore delineato Monette sublevatos, oculosque quasi in vitam redire apparentissimos.

source: But the curling paper and translucent flames stirred once more.
target: Sed charta volvens ac flammae translucidæ iterum se moverunt.

source: In an instant, the drawing of Monette condensed into a ball, devoured by clear flames and absorbed into the dim Bottle of Fiction.
target: In momento, delineatio Monette in globum condensata est, flammis perspicuis devorata et in obscura Ampulla Ficticia absorpta.

source: Wh– Had it failed? Anthony’s heart squeezed tight again.
target: Heu—defecitne? Cor Antonii iterum arcte comprimitur.

source: Even a disciplined Hypnotist found it hard to stay calm in the face of this.
target: Etiam disciplinatus Hypnotista difficile invenit se ante hoc quietum manere.

source: Right then, Overseer Perle, still next to the jutting rock, pulled her right hand from the Under the Table bag of coins.
target: Iam statim, Praefecta Perle, adhuc iuxta rupem protuberantem, dextram manum ex sacculo monetae "Sub Mensa" extraxit.

source: The transaction was made; Lumian’s group would teeter on the edge of sleep!
target: Negotium peractum est; cohors Lumiani in limine somni trepidabit!

source: Perle looked back at her target.
target: Perle ad metam suam respexit.

source: Lumian stood firm, wearing a gold mask painted black and white.
target: Lumian firmiter stetit, larvam auream nigro atque albo pictam gerens.

source: His aura was gone, body radiating an icy breath of death.
target: Aura eius evanuit, corpus autem spiritum mortis glacialem effundebat.

source: But Lumian’s now blue eyes stayed open.
target: Sed oculi Lumiani, nunc caerulei, manebant aperti.

source: As an Overseer, Perle knew something was wrong.
target: Ut praefecta, Perle intellexit aliquid male esse.

source: About to act, a thick darkness swallowed her, snuffing out the carbide lamp.
target: Acturum, densae tenebrae eam voraverunt, exstinguentes lampam carbidicam.

source: Perle’s eyes shut as she swayed unsteadily.
target: Oculi Perle se claudebant, dum instabiliter vacillabat.

source: She fell asleep.
target: Dormivit.

source: Somehow, the sleep effect meant for Lumian’s team had hit her instead, leaving them untouched.
target: Quidam modo, effectus somni ad turmam Lumiani destinatus eam percussit, eos tamen intactos relinquens.

source: Seeing this, Lumian felt shock, then immense joy.
target: Hoc videns, Lumian stupefactus est, deinde immensam laetitiam sensit.

source: He sensed a strange power pulsing from the Bottle of Fiction he had made with his body.
target: Sensit vim insolitam ex Ampulla Ficticia, quam corpore suo confecerat, palpitare.

source: Did it work?
target: Operatumne est?

source: Had Anthony done it?
target: Num Antonius id fecerat?

source: As expected, the entity’s prior actions sought to help His father.
target: Ut exspectabatur, praecedentes actiones entitatis patrem suum adiuvare conabantur.

source: And His father is on our side against heretics!
target: Et pater eius est in nostra parte contra haereticos!

source: Lumian quickly deactivated the Bottle of Fiction, ready to teleport to the sleeping Perle.
target: Lumian celeriter Ampullam Ficticiam deactivavit, paratus ad Perle dormientem translocari.

source: He would get Moran Avigny’s mirror and try to escape through the mirror world’s set entrance.
target: Accipiet speculum Moran Avigny et conabitur per ianuam statutam mundi speculi effugere.

source: If he could just get out, he could find help to make Perle leave.
target: Si tantum extrahere posset, auxilium invenire posset ut Perle discederet.

source: Just then, Perle’s coin bag and Moran Avigny’s mirror fell to the ground.
target: Tunc, sacculus monetae Perle et speculum Moran Avigny in terram caderunt.

source: Smack!
target: Ictus!

source: Moran Avigny’s mirror broke, cracking the entire mirror world barrier.
target: Speculum Moran Avigny confractum est, totum obstaculum mundi speculi scindens.

source: Perle, driven by flaming ambition, woke up with a start.
target: Perle, studio flammeo incitata, repente evigilavit.

source: As Lumian’s hopes sank, a shadow raced out of the shattered mirror.
target: Dum spes Lumiani labefactabant, umbra ex speculo confracto celeriter effugit.

source: It combined with strewn bits of flesh and blood, instantly reforming into Mr. K in his black robe.
target: Ea miscuitur cum sparsis particulis carnis et sanguinis, statim in Mr. K in nigra toga reformata.

source: When the mirror world took damage, the Aurora Order Oracle felt his finger and teleported on instinct, turning to shadow to slip through the cracks.
target: Cum mundus speculi laesionem passus est, Oraculum Ordine Aurorae digitum suum sensit et instinctu translocationem sumpsit, in umbram convertens ut per fissuras se insinuaret.

source: In the dark cathedral in an unknown location, Magician Blinked over and over, unable to shake off the flood of random information.
target: In obscura cathedrali in loco ignoto, Magus iterum atque iterum oculos micavit, neque potuit inundationem informationum fortuitarum abstinere.

source: As she Blinked, starlight filled her eyes, solidifying into a weird, ancient stone wall clock.
target: Dum illa oculos micabat, lumen stellarum oculos eius replebat, solidificans in insolitum et antiquum horologium lapideum murale.

source: Clang!
target: Clang!

source: Grand, majestic chimes echoed in every nook of the cathedral.
target: Magnae et magnificae campanae in omni angulo cathedralis resonaverunt.

source: An old, mottled phantom appeared in the air–a stone wall clock split into twelve sections, each crossing grayish-white or bluish-black symbols.
target: Phantasma vetus et maculatum in aere apparuit — horologium lapideum murale in duodecim partes divisum, quarum singulae symbola albo-cinerea vel nigro-caerulea ostendebant.

source: Clang!
target: Clang!

source: The chimes carried an unspeakable, invisible torrent through long ages past, freezing all present.
target: Campanae torrentem ineffabilem et invisibilem per longas aetates praeteritas ferebant, omnia praesentes congelantes.

source: The horrifying torrent of information froze.
target: Terrorificus torrentis informationum stetit congelatus.

source: Hermit, changed into an incomplete Mythical Creature, stopped cold.
target: Eremita, in creaturam mythicam imperfectam conversus, subito sistit.

source: Judgment, floating over the cathedral, turned to a statue.
target: Judicium, super cathedral levitans, in statuam conversum est.

source: Loki’s hand, reaching into the void, also paused, failing to pull out a silhouette.
target: Manus Loki, in vacuum extendens, quoque cessavit, neque silhouetum extrahere potuit.

source: In this frozen state, the starlight in Magician’s eyes changed again.
target: In hoc statu congelato, lumen stellarum in oculis Magi iterum mutatum est.

source: Countless complex mercury symbols appeared, quickly joining into a huge, unreal, scaleless serpent.
target: Innumerabilia symbola mercurii, intricata, apparuerunt, celeriter iungentes se in magnam serpentem, incredibilem et sine squamis.

source: The silver-white giant snake, layered with dense patterns and symbols, made connected cylinders with different markings.
target: Serpens giganteus argenteo-albus, stratis densus et symbolis ornatus, cylindros connexos cum insigniis diversis formavit.

source: The next second, the mercury serpent bent to bite its tail before it began slowly turning.
target: Secundo proximo, serpens mercurii se inclinavit ad caudam suam mordendum, antequam lente converteretur.

source: The massive torrent of information started to reverse, going back the way it came until it turned back into the woman in the black dress with the gold crown.
target: Magnus torrentis informationum revocari incipiebat, rediens per viam unde venit, donec iterum in feminam in veste nigra coronata corona aurea versa est.

source: The black-dressed woman faded, becoming a ghost and a floating, oddly captivating tarot card. In the end, both went back to the void and disappeared.
target: Femina veste nigra induta evanuit, facta umbra et charta taroti volitans, insolitè captivans. Denique, ambae ad vacuum redierunt et evanuerunt.

source: Fallen rocks flew back to Hermit’s body, turning back to eyes or pure white. Hermit quickly lost her terrifying look that would make anyone go mad.
target: Saxa lapsa ad corpus Eremitae revenerunt, in oculos aut purum album iterum convertentes. Eremita celeriter amisit aspectum terribilem, qui quemquam insanum facere posset.

source: Judgment returned to the surface, going back past the “door” as the mystery-weakening limit faded.
target: Judicium ad superficiem rediit, transeundo portam, dum terminus ad mysteria debilitanda evanuit.

source: Loki drew back his hand, settling into the pitch‑black wooden chair.
target: Loki manum retraxit, et in sellam lignea nigerrimam consediit.

source: In the fractured special mirror world, Overseer Perle saw the hooded, black‑robed Mr. K and his many sins upon waking up.
target: In mundo speculi speciali fracto, Praefecta Perle, evigilans, vidit Mr. K, cucullo indutus et veste nigra, atque multa peccata eius.

source: Oddly, the criminal who had done worse things than Lumian only had a small gray spot.
target: Insuete, sceleratus, qui peiora quam Lumian perfecerat, tantum parvam maculam cineream habebat.

source: This suggested that finishing an Under the Table transaction with Mr. K would be hard, as if it needed certain conditions.
target: Hoc suggerit finem transactionis "Sub Mensa" cum Mr. K difficultatem esse, quasi certis condicionibus egentem.

source: It seems to come from extreme devotion.
target: Videtur ex extrema devotione provenire.

source: All Under the Table transactions can only keep going with the permission of the one he has faith in…
target: Omnes transactiones "Sub Mensa" perseverare possunt solum cum licentia eius, in quem fidem habet…

source: As Perle’s mind raced, she glared at Mr. K and said with the Words of Order, “You stand guilty! You murdered someone!”
target: Dum mens Perle celerrime versabatur, illa Mr. K aspiciens, verbis ordinationis affirmavit: "Culpam geris! Aliquem interfecisti!"

source: The space over Mr. K went dark at once as something awful took shape.
target: Spatium super Mr. K simul obscuratum est, cum aliquid horribile formam summittere coepit.

source: Having heard Lumian talk about Jebus’s powers, he knew a deadly punishment was coming. He quickly changed his Grazing target, using Devil Transformation and Rose Bishop’s flesh and blood magic to endure the unknown attack.
target: Audito Lumiano de potentia Jebus, scivit mortalem poenam venturam esse. Celeriter metam suam "Grazing" mutavit, utens Transformatione Diaboli et magia carnis et sanguinis Rosae Episcopi, ut ignotum impetum ferre posset.

source: But in a flash, the growing penalties vanished, as if going to an unknown place.
target: Sed in momento, poenae crescentes evanuerunt, quasi ad locum ignotum se transferentes.

source: The scary pressure, like thick smoke, blew away in fierce winds.
target: Pressura terribilis, sicut fumus densus, in ventis ferocibus evanuit.

source: Mr. K was stunned for a moment before exploding in crazed laughter.
target: Mr. K per momentum stupefactus fuit, deinde in risu insaniente erupit.

source: “Haha! Hahaha!
target: "Haha! Hahaha!

source: “I’m guilty, but the Lord carries my sins!”
target: "Ego culpam habeo, sed Dominus peccata mea portat!"

source: “I’m innocent. I’m innocent to this world!”
target: "Innocens sum. In hoc mundo innocens permaneo!"

source: Amid the laughter, Mr. K changed Grazing targets.
target: Inter risum, Mr. K metam "Grazing" mutavit.

source: Layers of unreal doors showed up in his eyes.
target: Strata ianuarum irrealium in oculis eius apparuerunt.

source: Many doors to different places came together, turning into ghostly books.
target: Multae ianuae ad loca diversa confluere coeperunt, in libros spectra transformantes.

source: The book materialized in front of Mr. K, pages flipping fast.
target: Liber coram Mr. K apparuit, paginas celeriter volventes.

source: “I came, I saw, I recorded.”
target: "Veni, vidi, conscripsi."

source: As the ethereal voice rang out, the illusory book stopped on a page.
target: Dum vox aetheria resonabat, liber illusorius in una pagina sistit.

source: In an instant, Mr. K turned into a two‑ to three‑meter‑tall half‑giant in cold black armor, holding a pitch‑black sword.
target: In instante, Mr. K in semigitaneum, duorum ad trium metrorum altitudinem, in frigida armatura nigra versus est, gladium nigerrimum tenens.

source: He sprinted towards the Overseer.
target: Ad Praefectam impetu cucurrit.

source: “Praise you!” Mr. K roared, slicing down with the Sword of Darkness.
target: «Laudo te!» clamitavit Mr. K, gladium tenebris stridens deorsum feriens.

source: Perle’s face went grim, seeing the prosecution had no effect on Mr. K.
target: Vultus Perle adstrictus factus est, cum animadverteret persecutionem nullum in Mr. K operari.

source: Of course, as a demigod, though caught off guard, she knew what to do.
target: Scilicet, ut semideus, quamvis inopinata, scivit quid faciendum esset.

source: Amid Mr. K’s wild laughter, she stressed with the Words of Order, “An Overseer is protected!”
target: Inter risum insanum Mr. K, illa verbis ordinationis affirmavit: "Praefecta protegetur!"

source: The black‑armored half‑giant used all his might, slashing at Perle’s head with the dark broadsword, but an unseen barrier blocked it.
target: Semigitaneus in armatura nigra omni vi utebatur, caput Perle latum gladium obscurum caedens, sed barriera invisibilia illud impediverunt.

source: The barrier cracked.
target: Barriera fracta est.

source: Mr. K’s body quietly fell apart.
target: Corpus Mr. K silentio dissortium est.

source: A clean cut took off his right arm and shoulder, dropping them to the ground.
target: Incisio nitida dextrum brachium et humerum eius abstulit, eos in terram deiecit.

source: Though Mr. K used recorded demigod powers and had a bit of godhood, he still faced punishment for attacking a “clearly” protected Overseer.
target: Quamquam Mr. K potestates semidei memoratas adhibuit et aliquantum divinitatis possidebat, tamen poenam subire debuit propter impetum in praefectam manifestè protegitam.

source: This was a freshly done crime, not yet borne!
target: Hoc erat crimen recens commissum, nondum pertulit!

source: The flesh on Mr. K’s shoulder writhed, as if a new arm would grow. But he ignored it.
target: Caro in humero Mr. K contorquebatur, quasi novum brachium crescere velletur; sed id non curavit.

source: His left hand grabbed the falling dark sword, yelling again, “Praise you for creating everything!”
target: Manus sinistra gladium obscurum cadentem apprehendit, iterum clamans: "Laudo te quod omnia creasti!"

source: As the rough voice echoed, the dark broadsword slashed at Overseer Perle.
target: Dum vox aspera resonabat, gladius latus obscurus in Praefectam Perle incidens caedebat.

source: With Perle’s former protection, the dropped coin bag floated back to her hand.
target: Cum pristina protectione Perle, sacculus monetae lapsus ad manum eius revolavit.

source: She quickly made an Under the Table deal aimed at everyone there.
target: Celeriter commercium "Sub Mensa" omnibus illic destinatum instituit.

source: Crack!
target: Crepitus!

source: As the dark broadsword swung, the unseen barrier guarding the Overseer fully shattered.
target: Dum gladius latus obscurus osculabatur, barriera invisibilis, quae Praefectam protegēbat, plene confracta est.

source: Mr. K’s left arm came off his body, showing a huge cut.
target: Brachium sinistrum Mr. K e corpore eius abscissum est, demonstrans magnum laesum.

source: In the cut, blood‑colored flesh tendrils grew fast, as if alive, as if a new Mr. K would emerge.
target: In laesione, filiculae carnis, sanguine coloratae, celeriter creverunt, quasi vivae essent, quasi novus Mr. K oriri posset.

source: Overseer Perle wasn’t happy. Based on the Under the Table deal, Mr. K, Lumian, and the rest should have gotten much weaker.
target: Praefecta Perle non laeta erat. Secundum commercium "Sub Mensa", Mr. K, Lumian, et ceteri multo debiliores fieri debuerunt.

source: But in truth, nothing changed!
target: Sed re vere, nihil mutatus est!

source: Could it be that I’m unlucky?
target: Fortasse infortunata sum?

source: The person who made the deal was a fraud who never meant to keep their end?
target: Is qui commercium fecit, impostor erat qui numquam partem suam servare voluit?

source: Perle’s heart sank as she couldn’t move for some reason.
target: Cor Perle demissum fuit, quoniam, qua causa, movere non poterat.

source: Then she saw the armless Mr. K bow in an exaggerated way.
target: Tum vidit Mr. K, sine armis, in modum exaggeratum se inclinare.

source: The Aurora Order Oracle’s mouth opened as wide as it could, corners going to his ears. Blood churned where it tore, flesh tendrils thickly covering the spot.
target: Os Oraculi Ordine Aurorae quam late aperuit, angulos ad aures eius tendentes. Sanguis cum turbatione fluxit ubi lacerationem fecit, et filiae carnis spissae locum tegentes.

source: Using his stretched mouth, the black‑armored Mr. K bit the dark sword’s handle.
target: Utendo ore suo extenso, Mr. K, in armatura nigra indutus, manubrium gladii obscuri mordebat.

source: He jumped high, voice ringing from his chest.
target: Altum saltavit, voce ex pectore resonante.

source: “Praise you for bearing the world’s sins!”
target: "Laudo te quod peccata mundi tulisti!"

source: Amid hoarse yells, Mr. K fell, a straight dark sword using himself as the grip, slashing at Overseer Perle.
target: Inter voces rauces, Mr. K cecidit, gladium obscurum rectum se ipse quasi manubrium habens, in Praefectam Perle incidens.
